items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, did you know Hilton Jefferson up there? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah, Jeff? Jeff was up there. He's from Boston.

ctx.x: came back, he said he played with Chick Webb, and he came back and he hung around again -- meanwhile, Walter Johnson had opened a nightclub up there on Dudley Street, around there, and so I had the band, see, and I used to play up there, and oh -- it didn't last long because they raided it.
Well, did you know Hilton Jefferson up there?
Oh yeah, Jeff? Jeff was up there. He's from Boston.
